get.description: Public. 503 when the database does not answer.

post.summary: Create an account and send the verification mail
post.description: Always 204, also when the email is taken (the owner gets a mail instead).

post.summary: Confirm an email with the token from the verification mail
post.description: The token is single use and valid for 24 hours.

post.summary: Send the verification mail again
post.description: Always 204, whether or not the account exists.

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description: Registers the calling device from the X-Platform, X-Device and X-App-Version headers.

429.description: Too many attempts from this address, or too many failures for this email

schema.description: Too many attempts from this address, or too many failures for this email

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair
post.description: The presented token is spent. Reusing a spent token revokes every token of that session.

post.summary: Revoke the session of a refresh token
post.description: Ends that session on its device. Always 204, also for an unknown token.

post.summary: Send a password reset mail
post.description: Always 204, whether or not the account exists.

post.summary: Set a new password with the token from the reset mail
post.description: Logs every session of the account out.

get.summary: Current user, every profile tier included
get.description: Public, friends-only and private information, email, linked providers.

patch.description: Each tier sent replaces the stored one. publicInfo: everyone, friendsInfo: accepted friends, privateInfo: only you.

put.description: Needs the current password; 403 INVALID_CREDENTIALS when it is wrong. Logs every other device out.

get.summary: Search users by display name prefix
A user profile, filtered by relationship
get.description: Strangers get publicInfo, friends also friendsInfo, the owner everything.

post.summary: Send a friend request
post.description: If that user already asked you, you become friends.

post.summary: Accept the request sent by user :id
post.description: 404 when that user has no pending request to the caller.

delete.summary: Decline the request from, or cancel the request to, user :id
delete.description: 404 when there is no pending request between the two users.
Also revokes the device control each one gave the other.

get.description: Cached for 5 minutes. 503 CATALOG_BUSY when the Deezer quota is used up.

get.summary: One track, with a fresh preview URL
get.description: Preview links expire after a few minutes: ask again right before playing. 404 TRACK_NOT_FOUND for an id Deezer does not know.
From Deezer, cached for a day.

get.summary: Events I can see: public, invited or mine
get.description: Private events of other people are never listed. Paginated with limit and offset.

post.summary: Create an event
post.description: The caller becomes the owner. A LOCATION vote license needs a zone.

get.description: Private events answer 404 to people who are not invited.

patch.description: Making a public event private removes from its live room whoever can no longer see it.

delete.description: Everybody in its live room is told with event:deleted.

post.summary: Invite a user (owner)
post.description: Idempotent. 404 when the user does not exist.

delete.description: On a private event the user also leaves its live room at once.

get.summary: Now playing, ranked queue and my votes
get.description: Same state as the event:state broadcast, plus the entries the caller voted for.

post.summary: Suggest a track
post.description: Counts as your vote. A track already queued gets your vote instead of a second entry.

post.summary: Vote for a queued track
post.description: Idempotent: voting twice keeps one vote.

delete.description: Idempotent. 409 STALE when the track already played.

post.summary: Skip to the most voted track (owner)
post.description: currentEntryId is the entry the caller saw playing; 409 STALE if it already changed.

get.summary: Playlists I can see: public, shared with me or mine
get.description: Private playlists of other people are never listed. Paginated with limit and offset.

post.summary: Create a playlist
post.description: The caller becomes the owner.

get.description: Private playlists answer 404 to people who are not members.

patch.description: Making a public playlist private removes from its live room whoever can no longer see it.

delete.description: Everybody in its live room is told with playlist:deleted.

get.description: Visible to whoever can see the playlist, at most 500.

post.summary: Invite a member (owner)
post.description: Idempotent. 404 when the user does not exist.

delete.description: On a private playlist the user also leaves its live room at once.

get.summary: Entries in order, with the playlist version
get.description: Same state as the playlist:state broadcast.

post.summary: Add a track
post.description: afterEntryId: null puts it first, omitted puts it last. The same track may appear several times. 422 LIST_FULL at 500 entries.

get.description: A device is registered at login from the client headers.

patch.description: 404 for a device of somebody else.

put.description: Optional expiresAt. 403 NOT_FRIENDS when the user is not a friend.

post.description: 409 ACCOUNT_EXISTS when the email already has an account: log in and link instead.

post.description: 409 ACCOUNT_EXISTS when the email already has an account: log in and link instead.

post.description: 409 PROVIDER_IN_USE when that Google account belongs to another user.

post.description: 409 PROVIDER_IN_USE when that Facebook account belongs to another user.
